patrimoine.intro.n1: A private, solo and free initiative to help identify Tunisia’s heritage — whether architectural, human, social, cultural or historical. There’s no company or organisation behind it: just a lot of time spent, on my own, coding it and keeping it running.
patrimoine.intro.n2: At present, the only database available is that of the National Heritage Institute (INP). It is lacking in many respects: royalty-free photographs, up-to-date and comprehensive information on the actual condition of the sites, and details of whether or not urgent conservation action is required.
patrimoine.intro.n3: We do not collect money here: it is neither our purpose nor our aim. However, information that has been gathered, verified and compiled into a single document could serve as a starting point for others to take action to preserve it.
patrimoine.intro.n4: This list is intended to raise awareness of a heritage that we live alongside without always realising it, to look after it, and to remain vigilant against abuses.
patrimoine.intro.n5: The Heritage section is part of a wider app — available on the App Store, coming soon to the Play Store, and already available as a web version (PWA). This app is free for 15 days, after which a subscription is required; however, access to the ‘Heritage’ section remains available, in several languages, beyond the two-week period — and for life. The paid section never encroaches on the ‘Heritage’ section: the two are independent of one another.
patrimoine.intro.inp: ⚠️ The INP’s involvement is, for the time being, merely a hope, not a done deal: the invitation remains open to them. To date, no agreement has been reached. The fact sheets are based on their publicly available data. Watch this space.
patrimoine.apropos.m1: Fact sheets to be expanded, together. The fact sheets are based on public data from the INP (currently covering historical and architectural heritage only). The idea is for every citizen to help edit and expand them.
patrimoine.apropos.m2: Contribute. Access is free and requires no login details. By clicking on a site, anyone can fill in a supplementary form — including photos (if available), history, captions and additional information. To contribute, you simply need to provide your surname, first name and email address.
patrimoine.apropos.m3: Moderation prior to publication. Once submitted, the entry is subject to moderation to prevent any misuse or the dissemination of inappropriate material. No contribution is published automatically. Final approval or rejection will be decided by a panel of experts. We would like to see members of the INP involved, and the invitation is open to them — but this is, as yet, merely a hope. The reasons for acceptance or rejection are visible.
patrimoine.apropos.m4: Once published, anyone can comment on it or add to it; the panel then decides whether or not to include the additions in the final version.
patrimoine.apropos.m5: Photos. If you publish a photo you have taken yourself, you agree to grant the rights to publish it — but you remain the owner, and will be credited and named each time it is used, without compensation.
patrimoine.apropos.m6: Governance. Identifiable and recognised moderators have limited access to contributions and are responsible for publishing them online. The panel of experts would have its own access; the administration oversees the whole process. The precise rules are yet to be defined.
patrimoine.apropos.m7: It’s always free. No financial contribution is required, nor will one ever be. Any attempt to use this platform to raise money does not originate from us. The content of the factsheets can be downloaded in PDF and HTML format at any time, and is kept up to date. A ‘Follow us’ section will allow you to receive notifications. The content is freely accessible: if others wish to use it to raise funds for conservation, they are free to do so — this will be a separate initiative, unrelated to ours.
patrimoine.legal.l1: Information provided for guidance only. The information presented — including contributions from members of the public — is provided for guidance only, without any guarantee as to its accuracy, completeness or timeliness.
patrimoine.legal.l2: User-generated content. The authors are solely responsible for the texts, photos and comments they publish. Despite moderation, errors or inappropriate content may remain: any content may be reported and removed upon request.
patrimoine.legal.l3: Photo rights. By submitting a photo, the contributor warrants that they hold the rights to it (or that it is royalty-free) and authorises its publication. They remain the owner and will be credited. In the event of a claim by a rights holder, the photo will be removed upon request.
patrimoine.legal.l4: Personal data. The surname, first name and email address provided when submitting a contribution are used solely to manage and moderate contributions and, where necessary, to contact you. They are neither resold nor passed on to third parties. You may request to view, correct or delete your data via the contact details below.
patrimoine.legal.l5: Non-profit status. This initiative does not raise any funds. Any requests for financial contributions made in its name are unrelated to it.
patrimoine.legal.l6: Trademarks and third parties. The names and trademarks mentioned (including the INP) are the property of their respective owners; their mention does not imply any affiliation or endorsement.
patrimoine.legal.l7: Limitation of liability. The service is provided ‘as is’. To the extent permitted by law, the initiative accepts no liability for any damage resulting from its use or from its unavailability.
patrimoine.legal.l8: Reporting & contact. To report abuse, request removal or exercise your rights: {contact}.
patrimoine.legal.l9: Updates. These notices may be updated; the current version is the one displayed here.
